Hello Anastasiia,

We would like to inform you that we can offer the same rate for this month’s extension. However, please note that the rate may change from next month onward depending on the updated rates.

We can extend your stay for this month at the same rate of AED 4,500 for 30 nights.

Kindly let us know if you would like to proceed with the extension.

Thank you.
